issues.detail: Assertion 1 is marked complete:true with only `contains` checks for AC-001/AC-002/AC-003 in the review report. A report that names AC-003 only in an inventory line (e.g. 'current acceptance set AC-001 to AC-003') without any disposition would pass, so the checks are necessary but not fully sufficient for 'accounts for every current ID'. This can only produce a lenient pass, never a false fail, and the catalog endorsed it.
issues.fix: In reviewer-18/spec.json checks entry for assertion 1, change "complete": true to "complete": false so the judge confirms each ID, including AC-003, has a disposition (permitted dependency with owner Documenter).

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition: a coherent STANDARD brownfield cycle in REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with complete, consistent records, a defect-free implementation whose tests pass, and AC-003 recorded as a Documenter dependency in both design and Tester report. Checks and invariants cannot fail a correct run; the only note is that assertion 1's complete:true is slightly lenient and could be left to the judge.
